title: Huntik 5D
summary: Huntik 5D is an interactive dark ride based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, located at the Magicland theme park (formerly Rainbow Magicland) which opened in Rome in 2011. The ride features an animated CGI story featuring the Huntik characters in 3D. It was produced by a collaboration of several companies, including Rainbow, Rainbow CGI, Alterface, Art Project, Vida Studio, Sample, Hytechnology and Alfa Park, and holds the record for being the largest 5D video game in Europe. It is one of three Huntik-themed attractions at the park, the others being the Yucatan/Huntik Spillwater ride and the Mechanical Megataur simulator.

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
The ride begins with a [[Holotome]] scan of [[Megataur]], [[Bazela's Hive]], [[Bazela's Insect]] and [[Cerberus]]. The ride then hurtles into an underground labyrinth. [[Dante Vale]] appears and summons [[Caliban|Powerbonded Caliban]]. The doors to the Seeker's Temple open and a herd of [[Jericho]] and [[Redcap]] Titans attack. The players work with Caliban to defeat them.

The ride arrives at a deep pool of lava where [[Efreet King]] resides. [[Cherit]] addresses the players but is attacked by [[Ammit Heart-Eater]]. The ride travels through an Egyptian tomb before [[Sophie Casterwill]] appears, trying to free a chained [[Megataur]] Titan, who has been captured by the Dark Guardians. With the help of the players, she defeats the puzzle and frees the fierce Titan who returns to his [[Amulet]] in her hand.

The ride moves to the ruins of a temple. All is quiet, when [[Bazela's Hive]] crawls out and begins spawning [[Bazela's Insect]] Titans. The players fight off the swarm before the ride hurtles through an abandoned castle that begins to collapse. [[Cerberus]] attacks but explodes after being shot by the players.

[[Lok Lambert]], [[Zhalia Moon]] and [[Kipperin|Powerbonded Kipperin]] arrive as a final battle ensues against more Jericho Titans. The players assist Lok who uses the [[Willblade]] to defeat them, before the temple explodes and the ride ends.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*''Huntik 5D'' was animated after the [[Season 2|second season]] had finished production, making it the last piece of video media to be produced in the franchise. 

*The storyline of ''Huntik 5D'' closely resembles concepts from the unreleased fourth ''[[Huntik Trading Card Game]]'' set, ''[[TCG:Labyrinth of Doom|Labyrinth of Doom]]''. The expansion’s title and cover art features Megataur as a central figure within a labyrinth, paralleling the ride’s portrayal of Megataur imprisoned by the Dark Guardians. As the TCG set was cancelled, it is possible that elements of its planned narrative and imagery were reused for the Magicland attraction.

full_text:
Huntik 5D is an interactive dark ride based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, located at the Magicland theme park (formerly Rainbow Magicland) which opened in Rome in 2011. The ride features an animated CGI story featuring the Huntik characters in 3D. It was produced by a collaboration of several companies, including Rainbow, Rainbow CGI, Alterface, Art Project, Vida Studio, Sample, Hytechnology and Alfa Park, and holds the record for being the largest 5D video game in Europe. The ride was hugely popular and won Best New Attraction of the Year at the 2011 Parksmania Awards. It is one of three Huntik-themed attractions at the park, the others being the Yucatan/Huntik Spillwater ride and the Mechanical Megataur simulator.

Plot

The ride begins with a Holotome scan of Megataur, Bazela's Hive, Bazela's Insect and Cerberus. The ride then hurtles into an underground labyrinth. Dante Vale appears and summons Powerbonded Caliban. The doors to the Seeker's Temple open and a herd of Jericho and Redcap Titans attack. The players work with Caliban to defeat them.

The ride arrives at a deep pool of lava where Efreet King resides. Cherit addresses the players but is attacked by Ammit Heart-Eater. The ride travels through an Egyptian tomb before Sophie Casterwill appears, trying to free a chained Megataur Titan, who has been captured by the Dark Guardians. With the help of the players, she defeats the puzzle and frees the fierce Titan who returns to his Amulet in her hand.

The ride moves to the ruins of a temple. All is quiet, when Bazela's Hive crawls out and begins spawning Bazela's Insect Titans. The players fight off the swarm before the ride hurtles through an abandoned castle that begins to collapse. Cerberus attacks but explodes after being shot by the players.

Lok Lambert, Zhalia Moon and Powerbonded Kipperin arrive as a final battle ensues against more Jericho Titans. The players assist Lok who uses the Willblade to defeat them, before the temple explodes and the ride ends.

Trivia

• Huntik 5D was animated after the second season had finished production, making it the last piece of video media to be produced in the franchise.

• The storyline of Huntik 5D closely resembles concepts from the unreleased fourth Huntik Trading Card Game set, Labyrinth of Doom. The expansion’s title and cover art features Megataur as a central figure within a labyrinth, paralleling the ride’s portrayal of Megataur imprisoned by the Dark Guardians. As the TCG set was cancelled, it is possible that elements of its planned narrative and imagery were reused for the Magicland attraction.
